chapter: Second day: early memories, London 1966 and other singers
title: Learning organ and piano at home
summary: She learned on the organ her mother had at home, later got a piano, and taught herself with her brother George helping.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
